query: Audit this project — how healthy is it?
expected_behavior: Orients on stack and entry points before judging
Covers OWASP Top 10:2025 categories including software supply chain failures and mishandling of exceptional conditions
Runs the real test suite and dependency audit tool and reports actual results
Delivers one severity-ranked list with file:line, a concrete failure scenario, and a fix direction per finding

query: Give me a prioritized list of what's wrong with this codebase.
expected_behavior: Leaves empty severity tiers empty rather than padding with style nits
Ends with the top 3 highest-leverage fixes

query: Review this one pull request diff for bugs.
expected_behavior: Does not invoke project-audit; treats it as a diff-scoped code review
